requirement: The `habeas-requirements` skill MUST direct agents to show the edits a review made to requirements outside its group in the same way as {cite}`requirements.cli.requirements_review_skill.present.mechanical` requires. It MUST also direct them to list every `{example}` a review added and to say that each one needs a test.
rationale:
The subject `requirements.cli.requirements_review_skill.present.outside` has three obligations for the `habeas-requirements` skill. It must direct agents to (1) show edits made outside the group in the same way as `present.mechanical` requires, (2) list every `{example}` a review added, and (3) say that each added example needs a test.

The test is `tests/authoring_cli.rs#fn[the_requirements_skill_shows_edits_outside_a_group_and_added_examples]`, marked `{test}` for the subject. It calls `assert_in_order` on `habeas-requirements`. That goes through `bundled_skill`, which joins `SKILL.md` and its reference files and collapses whitespace, and then `assert_text_in_order`. `assert_text_in_order` panics if a phrase is missing or comes after an earlier phrase's position. I read all three helpers.

The test asserts two phrases in order:
- `as a diff against that text, then a "Mechanical:" list` is the convention that the cited `present.mechanical` sets. It also checks that the outside-group instruction comes after that convention.
- `Show the edits reviewers made outside their group the same way, and list added `{example}`s, which each need a test` covers obligations 1 to 3. It names the same-way instruction, the listing of added examples, and the need for a test for each.

The skill's workflow step 4 in `assets/skills/habeas-requirements/SKILL.md` contains both phrases in that order.

The subject is satisfied by text in the skill, and a phrase-presence and ordering assertion is an appropriate check for that. Dropping or rewording any of the three directives would fail the assertion. The cited `present.mechanical` requirement, including not raising mechanical changes to new text as questions, is context and needs no test here.

text: The `habeas-requirements` skill MUST direct agents to show the edits a review made to requirements outside its group in the same way as {cite}`requirements.cli.requirements_review_skill.present.mechanical` requires. It MUST also direct them to list every `{example}` a review added and to say that each one needs a test.

The `habeas-requirements` skill MUST direct agents not to raise mechanical changes to new text as questions. For text that was already agreed or that the user supplied, it MUST direct agents to show the change as a diff against that text, followed by a list of the mechanical changes.
